text:
maria: opened PR #4827 — extracting telemetry helpers into packages/shared/telemetry. mostly file moves + a couple small cleanup changes. can someone take a look for style and any circular-dep fallout? https://git.redwood/infra/redwood/pull/4827

aj: on it, ping me if you want a quick pairing review.

kevin: I can do a pass in ~2h. rough size?

maria: ~40 files but 80% are moves. no behavioural changes except one helper that now returns typed payloads. also updated barrel exports. diff example:

```diff
- import { trackEvent } from 'platform/telemetry'
+ import { trackEvent } from 'shared/telemetry'
```

sophia: quick Q — did you keep the old path aliases intact for apps using them? last time we moved stuff and app builds broke due to stale tsconfig paths.

maria: yes, added a compatibility alias in tsconfig.base.json and left a deprecation note in the package README.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #4827 — running lint, unit tests, and build matrix.

ci-bot: lint FAILED in packages/app: packages/app/src/usage.ts:12:5  error  'Telemetry' is defined but never used  no-unused-vars

maria: thanks, fixing the unused import now. pushing a tiny follow-up commit.

drew: heads up — this touches eng-runtime imports. can we avoid introducing a direct import from shared -> runtime? that created a subtle cycle in the past. if necessary use a dynamic import or pass a thin adapter.

kevin: left one comment on the type re-export in packages/shared/index.ts — prefer explicit exports over re-exporting the whole types file. otherwise style lgtm.

aj: looks fine to me, left two small nits.

kevin: approving the PR from my side (comment: tiny re-export nit).

aj: approved.

sophia: approved pending green CI — i want to see build matrix pass before merge.

maria: thanks! planning to merge after CI passes and a 10m wait in case anyone else wants to object. will follow up if anything pops. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: all checks passed for PR #4827

deploy-bot: PR #4827 merged by maria at 1812345934

maria: merged — thanks everyone for the quick reviews. I'll open a follow-up to handle the remaining deprecation notices and add a short note to the migration doc.
